title: 26. How do I start the Editor?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I start the Editor.
short_answer: First make sure that you have opened an existing survey: Go to the 'Surveys' page and click the 'Open' icon of the survey you want to edit. From the 'Overview' page, click 'Editor' to open it and to start with the editing of your questionnaire.
procedure: Please make sure to save your work from time to time.
